description: Fetch a node by type and id — `{node: {...}}` when present, `{node: null}` when absent. An unknown `node_type` is REFUSED rather than answered `null`, because "no such type" and "no such node" are different facts and must not share one reply. Carries `discontinued`: true when an ACCEPTED Decision has withdrawn this node (OBSOLETES). READ IT — the stored `status` still records what was BUILT, so a withdrawn capability goes on saying `realized` and only this field tells you the thing is gone.
name: get_node
